friction.summary: WalletConnect signing on a custom network fails: xrpl-connect falls back to xrpl:${network.id}, but WalletConnect v2 empties requiredNamespaces so the wallet approves only its own chain (xrpl:0); the dApp's request(chainId: xrpl:lending-hackathon) is not in the session and rejects. Fix is to set walletConnectId to the wallet's chain.

xrpl.js 5.2.0-beta.1 validateLoanSet accepts GracePeriod 0/negative/NaN and PaymentTotal 0/negative/fractional (only isNumber is checked), so malformed loans pass client validation and fail only at rippled preflight

A LoanSet with Counterparty set but no CounterpartySignature passes xrpl.js validateLoanSet (both fields optional) and only fails on-chain with temBAD_SIGNER; the SDK could catch the incomplete dual-signature shape
A plain LoanPay on an overdue instalment returns tecEXPIRED; it needs the tfLoanLatePayment flag, which the code does not hint at
The reference lending UI registers the WalletConnect adapter only when NEXT_PUBLIC_WALLETCONNECT_PROJECT_ID is set, so out of the box it cannot connect to the event's own WalletConnect browser wallet

error_codes.actual_mistake: Counterparty set without a CounterpartySignature; xrpl.js accepted the incomplete shape and the ledger rejected it
overdue instalment paid without tfLoanLatePayment; the code does not point at the missing late-payment flag

abandoned.blocked_at: the loan instalment was overdue, so it returned tecEXPIRED; switched to tfLoanLatePayment

workarounds.what: added walletConnectId 'xrpl:0' to the app's custom hackathon network so the dApp signs on the chain the WalletConnect wallet actually approves

single_fix: Give xrpl-connect first-class support for custom-network WalletConnect chain ids (and document that WalletConnect v2 drops requiredNamespaces, so the dApp's requested chain must equal the wallet's advertised chain). A malformed or fallback chain id silently blocks every signed transaction through a WalletConnect wallet.
not_observed: No verbatim developer XRPL doc-questions this period (autonomous UI testing and debugging).

The xrpl.js validateLoanSet permissiveness and the Counterparty-without-signature temBAD_SIGNER are parallel public-Devnet probe reflections in the hook buffer; exact repro counts were not independently observed in the main transcript.
Whether the dev wallet's manual/custom network submits to the hackathon WSS (vs only signing) was not separately confirmed; the deposit validating on the hackathon devnet is consistent with it.
The redeem flows were set up but not yet executed at the time of this checkpoint.
